sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_id" AS e, "Product_Categories"."product_type_description" AS g, AVG((CAST(("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_total_cost" - "Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_product_cost") AS REAL) / "Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_product_cost")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "Invoice_Line_Items" JOIN "Products" ON "Products"."product_id" = "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_id" JOIN "Product_Categories" ON "Product_Categories"."production_type_code" = "Products"."production_type_code" GROUP BY "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_id", "Product_Categories"."product_type_description"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m2" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, SUM("s3"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s3"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s3" GROUP BY "s3"."g"
